observations.why: Imperative 'Forget' carries high-arousal urgency in a negative valence — a forceful directive to erase, not a calm request.
Categorical imperative 'Remove all' signals urgent, high-arousal erasure with negative valence — no hedging or softening present.
Flat declarative correcting a record — low arousal, negative valence; resignation or weariness in having to state what should not need stating.
